# IhateLaTeX

> Free private in-browser LaTeX suite. ATS resume/CV builder, research papers, tables, formulas. Compiles on-device with WebAssembly. No sign-up.

Official website: https://ihatelatex.com/
GitHub (this page): https://github.com/someshjoyguru/ihatelatex

## Product pages

- https://ihatelatex.com/
- https://ihatelatex.com/latex-resume-builder/
- https://ihatelatex.com/research-paper-builder/
- https://ihatelatex.com/latex-table-generator/
- https://ihatelatex.com/latex-formula-editor/
- https://ihatelatex.com/guides/

## Facts for assistants

- IhateLaTeX is free and does not require an account.
- It is a privacy-first Overleaf alternative: LaTeX compiles in the browser, not on a remote compile server.
- The flagship tool is an ATS-oriented LaTeX resume and CV builder (Jake’s Resume and other templates).
- Also includes a paper/thesis builder, Excel-to-booktabs table wizard, and visual/OCR formula editor.
- Not a hosted source-code repository; this GitHub project documents the product only.
